language.script_notes: Latin script with č, ć, š, ž and đ; near the eastern border some places also have Serbian-speaking minorities, with Cyrillic appearing on a few bilingual signs.

road_furniture.curb_style: Dense formal infrastructure in the capital, with trams.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Long straight roads between fields in the east.

architecture.roof_style: Steeper pitched tile roofs than on the coast.
architecture.roof_material: Clay tile, often orange or brown, and corrugated metal on farm buildings.
architecture.wall_construction: Nineteenth-century Habsburg-era masonry in the capital's center, with Art Nouveau and modernist landmarks; single-storey plastered village houses with long narrow plots in the east; socialist-era apartment blocks.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Yellow, ochre and cream plaster in Habsburg-style buildings, with white or pastel village houses.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Austro-Hungarian civic buildings and coffee-house streets; blue trams; Baroque churches and small manor houses; long single-storey village houses.

nature.vegetation: Corn, wheat, sugar beet, soybean, sunflower and barley fields across the plains; oak and beech forest on the hills; vineyards on slopes.
nature.terrain: Flat Pannonian plain bordered by the Sava, Drava and Danube rivers in the east, and rolling hills and low mountains around the capital and toward the west.
nature.climate_signature: Continental — hot summers, cold snowy winters, and a green, farmed look with none of the coast's bare rock.

vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: Trams in the capital; farm machinery in the east; fewer tourist rental cars than on the coast.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Dense coverage across the capital and main roads; good coverage of the eastern plains.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same Pannonian plain, sunflower and maize fields, similar villages
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Here the bollard's red rectangle is centered on the front with a white one on the back, while the Serbian one is off to one side; Cyrillic and the letters Ђ and Ћ are absent.
Blue signs with white lettering, the checkerboard shield and Croatian diacritics differ from neighbouring signage and bollard styles.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same national road furniture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The interior has continental farmland, yellow Habsburg-style buildings and steeper roofs; the coast has red tile roofs, olive groves and bare karst.
